changes.text: 这时的国会人很少。同一天，日志记下一个付诸表决的问题：七个州出席的国会，是否有权接受总司令的辞职？日志留下了点名表决：在本篇所见的部分名单中，除帕特里奇投了反对外，其余议员均为赞成；其中埃勒里的反对票，日志记为应“该议员”的请求改成了赞成，没有写明这位议员是谁。这段摘录没有显示表决结果。22日的出席记录是马萨诸塞、罗得岛、宾夕法尼亚、特拉华、马里兰、弗吉尼亚和北卡罗来纳七个州，另有新罕布什尔和南卡罗来纳各一名议员。到了23日接见当天，国会还议决立即写信给新罕布什尔、康涅狄格、纽约、新泽西、南卡罗来纳和佐治亚六个州的行政长官，催他们的代表马上到会：国会在此开会期间，出席的从未超过七个州，其中多数只有两名代表，而批准正式和约等几件要务都需要至少九个州同意。

Congress was thin at the time. The same day, the journal records a question put to the vote: "Is it the sense of Congress that seven states in Congress Assembled are competent to receive the resignation of a Commander in Chief?" The journal kept the roll call. In the portion of the roll call cited here, every member voted ay except Partridge, who voted no; Ellery's no was recorded as "changed into ay at the request of the Member", and the journal does not say which member. This excerpt does not show the result of the vote. On the 22nd the states present were Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia and North Carolina, with one member each from New Hampshire and South Carolina. And on the day of the audience itself, the 23rd, Congress resolved to write at once to the executives of New Hampshire, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina and Georgia, demanding the immediate attendance of their delegates: during the sitting at this place there had never been more than seven states represented, most of them by only two delegates, and the ratification of the definitive treaty, among other matters, required the assent of at least nine states.
第二天，12月23日，星期二，接见如期举行。日志的写法很省：依照议决，总司令获准举行公开接见。
The next day, Tuesday, December 23, the audience took place as scheduled. The journal is spare about it: "According to order, his Excellency the Commander in Chief was admitted to a public audience".
说完，他走上前，把委任状和讲稿副本一并交给议长。委任状是权力的凭证，副本是这番说法的书面文本，两件东西一次交清。议定稿这一步留有方括号改动的痕迹，日志记下的结果是：由他本人走上前，交到议长手里。

With that, he stepped forward and placed his commission, together with a copy of his address, in the President's hands. The journal records it in one line: "He then advanced and delivered to the President his commission, with a copy of his address". The commission was the token of authority; the copy was the written text of what he had said. Two objects, delivered at once. The draft at this step carries bracketed changes; what the journal records is that he himself stepped forward and put the commission into the President's hands.
另有三处技术性保留。第一，议长的答词没有收进本篇证据包，本篇不予引用。第二，这份材料取自影印本的OCR识别，存在讹字，本篇英文引文只取清晰片段，可疑拼写一律留在引号之外。第三，日志印本以方括号标出议定稿中的改动字样，据编者注，方括号里的字出自博迪诺之手；本篇所据的OCR文本无法判断原稿另有哪些删改，本篇只转述方括号中的字样。

Three technical reservations follow. First, the President's reply is not in this article's evidence pack and is not quoted. Second, the material comes from OCR of a facsimile and contains misreadings, so the English quotations here take only clean stretches, with doubtful spellings left outside the quotation marks. Third, the printed journal marks changes to the draft protocol with brackets, and according to the editors' note the bracketed words are in Boudinot's writing; the OCR text this piece relies on cannot show whether the draft carries any other deletions or revisions, so this piece reports only what is in the brackets.

全部事实来自《大陆会议日志》第25卷的官方记录（1783年12月20日的来信、议决与关于七州权限的表决，12月22日议定的接见次序，12月23日的接见与华盛顿讲话文本）。没有在场者私人记述可对照，人物心情与现场反应不可知；议长答词未收入本篇证据包，本篇不引用；带括号改动的是接见次序的议定稿；材料经OCR识别，存在讹字，引文只取清晰片段；议定稿的改动在本篇所据的OCR文本中只能确认方括号内的字样（据编者注为博迪诺笔迹），其他删改无法判断。

All facts come from the official Journals of the Continental Congress, volume 25 (the letter, resolution and vote on whether seven states were competent, of December 20, 1783; the order of audience agreed on December 22; the audience and Washington's address of December 23). No private account by anyone present was available for comparison, so mood and reaction in the room are unknowable; the President's reply is not in this article's evidence pack and is not quoted here; the draft bearing bracketed changes is the protocol of the order of audience; the material was captured by OCR from a facsimile and contains misreadings, so quotations take only clean stretches; in the draft protocol, the OCR text this piece relies on confirms only the bracketed words (in Boudinot's writing, according to the editors' note), and any other deletions or revisions cannot be determined.

dispositions.rationale: 证据只收录了点名表决的一部分。原文“名单上列出的议员几乎都投赞成”已改为“在本篇所见的部分名单中，除帕特里奇投反对外均为赞成”，并补充说明这段摘录没有显示表决结果。中英两版同步修改。
